SELECT s.* FROM rag_chunk_search_index_state s JOIN rag_document_chunks c ON c.chunk_id=s.chunk_id WHERE c.document_id=#{documentId} AND c.use_yn='Y' ORDER BY s.chunk_id LIMIT 10001 FOR UPDATE
